c84025492.notes: White town-name road sign; a cyclist poses beside it (cap and sunglasses) with bikes. Sign extends past the right frame edge but the name is complete.

c8854120.notes: Hanging shop sign on Tela's main street. The apostrophe is a straight/typographic mark. Distractors further down the street (HSBC, KATRINY, Pepsi-style signs) are small.

c90607574.notes: Hand-painted pink sign, West End Roatán. 'CHIKEN' is misspelled on the sign (sic). The name is in decorative mixed-case lettering (looks like 'anThony's'). Distractors: Canopy/Gumbalimba vertical banners, scooter rental boards, Coca-Cola and Pepsi branding.

c90608124.notes: Market street in Tegucigalpa with pedestrians; target is the overhead white sign mid-frame. Distractors: 'tabcin' / 'FARMACIA LOUMAR', 'Hotel AMBAR', 'ISAAC', 'maxi', 'ESTACIONAMIENTO' arrow sign.
